title: App Store & Google Play Scraper: App Details & Metadata
desc: App metadata from the Apple App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android) in one run: name, description, price, rating and 1–5 breakdown, installs, version, release and update dates, developer contact, screenshots, in 174 countries. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API. No login.

title: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Jobs Scraper
desc: Scrape every open job from Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby job boards by company (board link, careers page, domain or name) or search a directory of 10,000+ company boards by title and location. Salary, remote, department, posted date, apply link. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Shopify Store Leads Finder (Emails, Phones, Socials)
desc: Find Shopify stores by what they sell, or enrich your store list: emails, phones, address, VAT number, social profiles, location, catalog size, newest product, price range, theme, installed apps. Ecommerce lead lists as CSV, JSON or API. Pay per lead; non-Shopify and closed domains free.

title: SECOP II Scraper: Colombia Tenders, Licitaciones & Contracts
desc: Colombia's public procurement from SECOP II: tenders (licitaciones, selección abreviada, mínima cuantía, concurso de méritos, subasta) with entity, base price, bids deadline and link, and signed contracts with supplier, NIT and value. Official open data. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: German Tenders Scraper: Ausschreibungen & Vergabe Notices
desc: German public tenders (öffentliche Ausschreibungen) from the official Bekanntmachungsservice (oeffentlichevergabe.de): every Vergabe notice above and below the EU thresholds, awards with winners, buyer email, CPV, deadline, Bundesland. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Brazil CNPJ Scraper (Receita Federal Company Data & Leads)
desc: Brazil CNPJ lookup (consulta CNPJ) and company search (empresas do Brasil) from the Receita Federal register: legal name, status, CNAE, address, phone, email, Simples/MEI, partners (QSA). Look up CNPJs in bulk or find leads by state, city, CNAE or size. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Workday Jobs Scraper: myworkdayjobs Career Sites & API
desc: Scrape Workday jobs from any myworkdayjobs.com career site, or by employer name (Walmart, NVIDIA): title, requisition id, locations, remote or hybrid, job type, posted date, department, description, apply link. Search, filters, only-new monitor. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: OCR: Image & PDF to Text — Scanned PDF, Screenshot, Photo OCR
desc: OCR API for images and PDFs: extract text from scanned PDFs, screenshots, photos, receipts and invoices, with line boxes, confidence and detected language. Reads a PDF's own text when it has one. 40+ languages, rotated pages fixed. Export to JSON, CSV, TXT or Markdown, or via API.

title: Career Site Jobs Scraper: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday
desc: Scrape job listings straight from company career sites on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workday (plus Recruitee, Personio, BambooHR, Breezy): title, department, location, remote, salary, posted date, apply link, description. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Website Screenshot API - Full Page, Mobile & PDF
desc: Take website screenshots of any URL list in bulk: full page or above the fold, desktop, mobile or custom size, PNG, JPEG or WebP, plus PDF. Wait for an element or a delay, hide cookie banners, dark mode. Each file is a public link with final URL and status. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Remote Jobs Scraper: We Work Remotely, Jobicy & Remote OK
desc: Scrape remote jobs (work from home) from We Work Remotely, Jobicy and Remote OK (remoteok.com): title, company, salary, where you may live, category, job type, description, posted date and board link, deduplicated. Filter by keyword, category, country. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Doffin Scraper: Norway Public Tenders (Anbud, Kunngjøringer)
desc: Norwegian public tenders and procurement notices (anbud) from Doffin by keyword, notice type, status, county, buyer, CPV code and date: contract notices, awards, intentions and DPS, with buyer org number, value, deadline, contact, lots and documents link. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Belgium Tenders Scraper: Public Procurement (e-Procurement)
desc: Belgian public tenders from publicprocurement.be (e-Procurement BDA) by keyword, notice type, CPV, region, procedure, buyer and deadline: contract notices, awards and corrections in NL, FR, DE, EN, with lots, buyer contact, value, winners and documents. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: BOAMP Scraper: French Public Tenders, MAPA & Award Notices
desc: BOAMP notices (marchés publics, appels d'offres) from DILA's official daily files: French public tenders (avis de marché, MAPA), awards with winners and SIRET, corrections. Filter by département, CPV, descriptor, buyer, keyword and deadline. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Baltic Tenders Scraper: Estonia & Latvia Public Procurement
desc: Public tenders and contract awards of Estonia (riigihanked.riik.ee) and Latvia (EIS, eis.gov.lv) from their official open data: buyer, registry code, CPV, deadline, estimated value, winners and amounts, daily monitoring of new notices. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Austria Tenders Scraper: Public Procurement Notices and Awards
desc: Austrian public tenders from the official USP Ausschreibungssuche (ausschreibungen.usp.gv.at): contract notices and awards by keyword, region, CPV code and day. Deadlines, buyer contacts, lots, award criteria, winners and contract values. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: News Article Extractor: Full Text from Any News Site
desc: News article extractor: full text (plain and Markdown), title, authors, dates, lead image, tags and paywall flag from any news site. Give article links, a section page, an RSS/Atom feed or a Google News sitemap. Headlines-only mode, date filter, only new. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API.

title: Google Play Scraper: App Data, Developers & Categories
desc: Google Play app data: name, description, price, rating and 1–5 star breakdown, installs, version, update date, developer email and website, screenshots. Find apps by link or package name, developer, category or similar apps, in 174 countries. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API. No login.
